{{Quote|They're on their way to Kaliida Shoals.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Kaliida Shoals''' was a celestial object<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]],<ref name="Ryndellia" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]'s [[Ryndellian sector/Legends|Ryndellian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] and the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|battle]] took place close to the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
